slides.headline: AI TOOLS *you didn't know about*
slides.body: Eight of them, quietly running real work right now.
slides.close: You've heard of maybe two. *Number 5 replaces an entire job.*

slides.headline: ELEVENLABS *clones your voice*
slides.body: About a minute of you talking and it builds a copy. Type anything and it comes back in your voice.
slides.close: It will also speak languages *you do not speak*.

slides.headline: NOTEBOOKLM TURNS FILES INTO *a podcast*
slides.body: Drop in your documents, hit audio overview, and two hosts show up and discuss your own notes like a real show.
slides.close: Your files, in your ears, *on the drive to work*.

slides.headline: LOVABLE *builds the app for you*
slides.body: Describe what you want in plain English. It writes the code, puts it on the internet, and gives you a link.
slides.close: People are shipping real products *without opening an editor*.

slides.headline: CURSOR WRITES CODE *next to you*
slides.body: It is a real code editor with AI built into every keystroke. It reads your whole project before it suggests anything.
slides.close: This is what most developers *actually switched to*.

slides.headline: N8N CONNECTS *everything you use*
slides.body: Drag boxes, draw lines between them, and your apps start talking. New form fills a sheet, sends an email, pings your phone.
slides.close: Automation without writing *a single line of code*.

slides.headline: FIGMA NOW *designs with you*
slides.body: The tool every designer already lives in. It now turns a description into a working layout you can click through.
slides.close: The gap between an idea and a mockup *basically closed*.

slides.headline: SUNO WRITES *actual songs*
slides.body: One sentence in, a full track out. Vocals, instruments, structure, the whole thing.
slides.close: People use it for background music and *nobody can tell*.

slides.headline: DESCRIPT EDITS VIDEO *like a document*
slides.body: It transcribes your footage, then you delete a word from the text and the video cuts itself.

slides.headline: COMMENT *STACK*
slides.body: I will send you all eight with the links and which ones have a real free tier.
slides.close: No email needed. Save this and *send it to whoever asks you what to learn*.
